declared_before_outcomes: No development or confirmation outcome from these streams has been generated. Prior 2026-10-10 outcomes motivated shrinkage; their failures remain binding.
seed_derivation: (root + domain*10000019 + (group+1)*1000003 + replicate*7919) mod 2147483646 + 1; Park-Miller 48271/2147483647 uniforms, Box-Muller Gaussians, voxel-major columns, 256 burn-in draws per run

development.role: candidate selection on JVM; no admission

confirmation.role: one frozen candidate, all five cells, JVM and JS

cells.truth: run phi (0.30,0.05) then (0.55,-0.15); same for every voxel

design: Unchanged corrected-GLS study design: two SPMG1 task epochs, run intercepts and six run-local DCT terms per run (16 columns), censor rows 23,24,60 then every 37 from 97 per run; voxel 0 null, voxel 1 task_a=0.75. Noise is continuous within each run; censoring never changes the generator.
estimator: One-pass OLS-design-corrected AR(2) per run, then phi_r(lambda) = lambda * phi_r + (1-lambda) * sum_s(n_s * phi_s) / sum_s n_s. Weights n_s are full run lengths fixed by the design. No spatial pooling, response-dependent weight fitting, clipping, rescue, or retry.
uncertainty: Experimental KR working inference: use per-run AR covariance derivatives. Apply A W A-transpose to the inverse expected REML information W, with identity on the scale and A_(r,l),(s,k) = indicator(l=k) * (lambda*indicator(r=s)+(1-lambda)*n_s/sum(n)). This is a first-order working approximation; shrinkage bias and finite-sample coverage are not assumed qualified.

engines.known-continuous: VoxelwiseArFgls Known(true phi per voxel/run), ContinuousMissing, Conditional
engines.run-shrink-075-kr: Run-shrunk lambda=0.75, correction ceiling 25, continuous missing covariance, transformed KR information
engines.run-shrink-050-kr: Run-shrunk lambda=0.50, correction ceiling 25, continuous missing covariance, transformed KR information

decisions: Candidate engines use p-values from the portable F upper tail with the reported numerator/denominator df (KR: scaled statistic and KR df). Existing engines keep the original fixed t/F critical values. Coverage is acceptance of H0 task_a=0.75 for voxel 1 at alpha 0.05.

acceptance.AR_mean_bias_rule: |bias| + qt(0.95, n-1) * sd/sqrt(n) <= 0.04 for each lag
acceptance.variance_ratio_rule: 90% percentile dataset-bootstrap interval of mean reported null variance / empirical null-estimate variance

candidate_selection: After development only, select the eligible candidate passing the largest total number of the eleven unchanged criteria across all five admission cells; ties choose lambda=0.75 (less shrinkage). Eligibility requires complete records and no refusals. Commit the chosen engine and source hashes before confirmation. If neither is eligible, retain the failures and do not consume confirmation.
confirmation_decision: Scientific pass requires every original criterion in every one of the five cells on both platforms and identical t/F/coverage decisions. No changed margins, cells, selective omissions, reruns with new seeds, or post-confirmation parameter tuning. A failure keeps the Mote scientifically open.
scope_limits: Experimental estimator; not exposed as a qualified FitPlan policy by this work.
No iterative/robust, arbitrary-order, spatial-pooling, or broader heterogeneity claim.
Previously observed streams and receipts are preserved and are not fresh confirmation evidence.
